subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ ‘B’ and ‘C’ to write five complete sentences. 1  5 =
stimulus: Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) People all over the world i. kind of events at different i. in history, tradition and (b) Their culture times religion. (c) They celebrate different ii. little over ii. the same culture. (d) Various celebrations iii. have their origin iii. the centuries (e) Some have changed iv. do not have iv. country to country. v. varies from v. of the yearly occasions.
guide_solution: (a) People all over the world do not have the same culture. (b) Their culture varies from country to country. (c) They celebrate different kinds of events at different times of the yearly occasions. (d) Various celebrations have their origin in history, tradition and religion. (e) Some have changed little over the centuries.
